title: Emscher sewer, PHOENIX See and Dortmund connect water with everyday services
summary: Two bounded projects and one municipality distinguish sewer operation, river recovery, lake stewardship and local services. Eligibility reaches 89 projects and 59 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Sixteen official German HTML bodies or scoped segments inspected November 22. Tests, operating milestones, historical monitoring, future targets and modelled outcomes remain distinct.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
